name: Marrowgnaw
place: dungeon crypt_spiral: floor 1's mini-boss (central vault, 30-34 m) — written to fit a 24 m room
_doc: Stream E. The ossuary's guard dog, fat on old bones. P1: a bleeding bite for the tank, a lunge, and a howl you must interrupt or rats pour in. P2 at 50% 'Bone-mad': it buries bones across the floor — the heaps it leaves are COVER — then shrieks with a line-of-sight scream: hide behind a bone heap. Heaps crack after two shrieks. Soft enrage from 3 minutes.
party: Solo: fine — interrupt the howl, use bone heaps for the shriek. 2-3: intended. 5: heaps are crowded cover (4 heaps of ~2 bodies each). M5 scaling: bone heaps = party size + 1; rats per howl 3 -> 2 solo.

pull: Marrowgnaw lifts its head from a heap of thigh bones and growls.
{boss} drops the bone it was chewing. It wants a fresh one.
say.death: Marrowgnaw whimpers once and lies down among its bones.
say.reset: Marrowgnaw goes back to its gnawing.

enrage.say: Marrowgnaw goes wild, snapping at everything!

lunge.name: Grave Lunge
lunge.say: {boss} drops low — get out from behind {target}!

howl.name: Ossuary Howl
howl.say: {boss} throws its head back to howl — stop it!

onInterrupt.say: The howl ends in a wet cough.

actions.say: Rats boil out of the bone heaps!

bury.name: Bury the Bones
bury.say: Marrowgnaw scatters bones across the floor.

shriek.name: Marrow Shriek
shriek.say: Marrowgnaw fills its lungs — get behind a bone heap!
